searchText: It might depend a bit on clients' exact timings (how long I/O vs execution takes) and how parallelization is implemented using BALs. The attack is more on the theoretical side, I'd agree with that, and is economically irrational as it would require to win a bid.

excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
It might depend a bit on clients' exact timings (how long I/O vs execution takes) and how parallelization is implemented using BALs. 
The attack is more on the theoretical side, I'd agree with that, and is economically irrational as it would require to win a bid.
